# Bizskoop

Bizskoop is a premier business consultancy in Malaysia, specializing in company formation (SSM), licensing, and corporate services.

## Core Services
- SSM Company Formation
- Global Immigration & ESD Agent Services
- Regulatory Licensing (Local Council, CIDB, Halal)
- Corporate Secretarial & Compliance
- Accounting & Tax Services
